{{Aries}}
Aries 20 is the 132nd day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 20th day of Aries, and it is a Saturday. It corresponds to ISO week 19, weekday 6.

Its informal Japanese name is 5宮20日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 132|Chapter 132]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152152}}.
